versions.changelog:
Initial release of btcvision-alert.

- Automatically sends Bitcoin price alerts for ±3% moves or when BTC crosses key levels.
- Integrates with Telegram, Discord, and Slack.
- Uses live price and sentiment data from BTCvision.org.
- Triggers alerts based on price change, fear & greed index, or user-defined thresholds.
- Includes easy setup instructions and recommended hourly check schedule.
